name: Emoji Launch

sources.title: Homepage — minimal launch board listing products with emoji, tagline, and launch date
Submit — 'Purchase a launch code on Gumroad, then enter it below'; single-use codes; fields and rules listed

requirements: Must be a product: app, tool, site, or hardware project
Must be ready to use — 'no waitlists, or coming soon pages'
No spam, adult, or misleading content
Requires a single-use launch code purchased on Gumroad (smithlabs.gumroad.com/l/opqqjo) — code is verified automatically at submission
preparation: One representative emoji for the listing
A chosen launch date — 'Your product will be listed on your launch day'
Gumroad purchase for the launch code (price not stated on the submit page)
workflow: Buy a launch code via the Gumroad link on https://emojilaunch.com/submit
Enter the launch code plus product details (name, tagline, emoji, URL, launch date, email)
Click 'Schedule Launch!' — the listing goes live on the selected launch day on the homepage 'Latest' feed
watchFor: No free route — every submission requires a paid single-use code
Launch code price is not shown until Gumroad checkout
Small site: listings are one line each (emoji + tagline + link with ?ref=emojilaunch); the latest entry shown was Aug 4, 2026 — modest volume
Listing dates appear user-scheduled, so homepage visibility depends on chosen launch date
countsAsLive: The product appears in the emojilaunch.com Latest feed with emoji, tagline, and outbound link on/after the scheduled launch date
unknowns: Launch code price at Gumroad checkout
Whether listings stay permanently or roll off after a period
Traffic volume — the board is extremely minimal with no categories or voting detail beyond small numbers
